measurement_role: derived from an existing profile; no runtime, timing, or performance claim

derived_run_fraction.basis: Each of the 8,080 generated payload trees takes the same 63-call recursion shape; the 80 run trees are 80/8,080 of the combined profile.

observed_hot_site_lower_bounds_per_run.basis: The listed hot edges account for 25,040 loads as the first opcode of an edge, plus 4,960 loads as the second opcode after Binary; the two entry load/store sites account for 10,080 stores. The profile report contains only its top 20 adjacent sites, so these are lower bounds for this function, not complete per-function totals.

interpretation.what_data_supports: At least 40,080 local load/store dispatches per run occur in the hot listed sites of GeneratePayloadTree: 30,000 loads and 10,080 stores. Loads immediately precede conditional, binary, and move operations in the hot recursive paths.
interpretation.what_data_does_not_prove: Adjacent opcode counts do not establish register def-use. They do not prove which local slot a load reads, whether the following instruction consumes that destination, or whether the result remains live elsewhere.
interpretation.next_required_data: Decode bytecode operands and run def-use/liveness over these weighted sites to identify loads that can be replaced by direct local locations, stores that can be absorbed into result destinations, and the resulting register/root-map cost.
